dimensions.assessment: Directly affects veterans, servicemembers, and qualified dependents transitioning to college life across all states, plus educational institutions.
dimensions.evidence: supports veterans, servicemembers, and qualified dependents who are transitioning from military service to college life.

dimensions.assessment: Expands the program to ensure counselor presence in every state, which provides administrative and supportive college transition services.
dimensions.evidence: ensure that at least one counselor of the VetSuccess on Campus program is located in each State

dimensions.assessment: The source does not provide specific dollar amounts or appropriations for expanding the counselors.
Modifies the reach of an existing Department of Veterans Affairs program to mandate presence in every state.
dimensions.evidence: require the Department of Veterans Affairs to ensure that the VetSuccess on Campus (VSOC) program is located in every state.

dimensions.assessment: Permanent statutory requirement for the Department of Veterans Affairs to maintain counselors in every state.
dimensions.evidence: The Secretary of Veterans Affairs shall ensure that the VetSuccess on Campus program... is located in every State.

missing_information: No specific funding amounts, cost estimates, or implementation timelines are provided in the source text.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill mandates that the Department of Veterans Affairs place at least one VetSuccess on Campus counselor in every state, expanding support for student veterans.
